# Soak USA — LLM-Friendly Site Summary

> Soak USA is a directory of hot springs, natural thermal pools, and geothermal soaking spots across the United States.

## About
- Domain: soakusa.net
- Type: Location directory
- Coverage: 14 US states with active listings, expanding nationwide, 360+ hot spring locations
- Data: GPS coordinates, water temperatures, amenities, access requirements

## Key Pages
- [Home](https://soakusa.net): Browse featured hot springs and search by state
- [Editorial](https://soakusa.net/editorial): In-depth guides and safety information
- [Privacy Policy](https://soakusa.net/privacy): MODPA/GDPR/CCPA compliant, honors GPC signals
- [About](https://soakusa.net/about): Mission and editorial standards
- [Contact](https://soakusa.net/contact): Get in touch

## Data Coverage
Hot springs are listed with: name, state, city, GPS coordinates, description, water temperature, amenities (pool, changing rooms, camping, wheelchair accessible), access type (free/fee), and safety notes.

## Safety Information
This site includes safety guidance for hot spring visitors: temperature checking, hydration, health conditions, and Leave No Trace principles.
